convention: Favourite setups for repeat dispatch. A roster is a list of seat names (identity in ../quarters/crew/crew.json, brief in the seat's dossier) and one line of shape. Teams flown from a roster are found in cockpit.json by the roster field.

rosters.name: recon
rosters.purpose: survey unknown terrain and cut candidate missions
rosters.shape: readers in parallel, verifier from the start, cutter waits for all; readers do not spawn subagents

rosters.name: mini-adversary
rosters.purpose: critique the pilot's own work before building
rosters.shape: independent, parallel, no cross-talk; warn that the ground may move

rosters.name: topics-and-records
rosters.purpose: mine the commander's statements into topics and distil records
rosters.shape: extractor first; discovery and validator as topics land; writer once topics are stable; adversary on every draft
